dict.string: MeshSonar connects to your MeshCore companion radio over Bluetooth to send wardriving pings, hear repeater echoes and carry your chat messages. It stays connected in the background so a drive, the Home observer and incoming messages keep working.

Take a photo to share in a chat. The photo is uploaded to MeshSonar's server so the chat link can show it (encrypted on this phone first in private chats; its location and camera details are removed). MeshSonar also uses the camera when you tap Scan QR code, to read a MeshCore channel or contact code; nothing from a scan is recorded.

Pick a photo to share in a chat. The photo is uploaded to MeshSonar's server so the chat link can show it (encrypted on this phone first in private chats; its location and camera details are removed).
Save a photo from a chat to your Photos.
MeshSonar can use Face ID to protect saved repeater and room passwords.
MeshSonar records where each ping was sent so your drive can be mapped, shows you on the coverage map and works out which MeshSonar region you are in.

While you record a drive, MeshSonar keeps placing each ping on the map when the screen is off or another app (like navigation) is in front. iOS shows a blue indicator while it does. Your position is not used in the background when you are not recording a drive, and is never put in the on-air ping. If Share what my radio hears is on, packets your radio hears in the background are sent to the server tagged only with the roughly 5 km area MeshSonar last knew (or nothing, if you chose Region only).
MeshSonar reads air pressure from your phone's barometer during a drive, to explain changes in radio range. It is saved with your drive. You can turn it off in Settings > Privacy & data sharing.
